name: fix-multiple-default-values
description: Add a missing allowed scheme to an img src URL rule. Multi-location edit task.
task: The DEFAULT_POLICY in src/justhtml/sanitize.py has a URL rule for ("img", "src") that specifies allowed_schemes. Currently it doesn't allow data: URIs for embedded images. Find the img src UrlRule and add "data" to its allowed_schemes list so inline base64 images work.
